## User Interface Behavior
- Show the 'Edit Billing' block only when the switch is activated, and position it below the product table.
- Ensure the invoice modal adjusts its height to the viewport without expanding its width, and the modal body should scroll if the content exceeds the viewport while keeping the footer always visible.
- Do not format or overwrite the field that the user is editing to avoid cursor jumping.
- Accept both point and comma as decimal separators correctly.
- Do not allow percentages greater than 100; show a warning and reset to 100 upon exiting the input field.
